ChatNow is an all-in-one AI assistant with 30+ of the top AI models in one place: GPT-6 Astra, Claude Fable 5.1, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Grok 4.5, and every new release that follows. Write, research, create images and video, and solve everyday or complex problems, without learning several tools, switching between apps, or paying for separate subscriptions.

Downloaded 13 million+ times* and rated 4.8 out of 5 from 400,000+ ratings and reviews.

HOW MANY AI MODELS ARE IN CHATNOW?
More than 30 today, covering chat and reasoning, images, and video. New flagship models are added as they launch, so you are never a generation behind.

WHICH AI MODELS ARE IN CHATNOW?
For writing, reasoning, and analysis: GPT-6 Astra, GPT-5.6 (Terra, Luna, Sol), GPT-5.5 Thinking, Claude Fable 5.1, Claude 4.8 Opus, Claude 5 Sonnet, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Gemini 3 Flash, Grok 4.5, Grok 4.3.
For images: Nano Banana Pro, Nano Banana 2, GPT Image 2, Flux.
For video: Veo 3.1, Sora 2, Kling 2.1, Seedance 2.5, Omni Flash.
This is not the full list. Open ChatNow for the current lineup.

WHICH MODEL SHOULD I USE?
Pick one in a tap, or ask several models the same question, compare the answers, and keep the best one.

CAN I USE GPT-6, CLAUDE, GEMINI, AND VEO WITHOUT SEPARATE SUBSCRIPTIONS?
Yes. One subscription covers all 30+ models instead of four or five separate bills.

Type, talk, or snap a photo and get a clear answer back.

KEY FEATURES

WRITING & GRAMMAR
Draft the email you keep putting off or turn messy notes into a clean report. Summarize, rewrite, translate, fix grammar, and polish your resume.

RESEARCH & SMART WEB SEARCH
Get up-to-date answers with sources: today's news, product comparisons, and fact checks on what you read online. Turn articles and PDFs into quick takeaways.

IMAGE & VIDEO CREATION
Generate images and edit photos with Nano Banana Pro and GPT Image 2. Make short videos with Veo 3.1, Sora 2, and Kling 2.1. New creative models land in Creative Studio right after release.

CODING
Describe your idea in Playground and watch it become a working app or website, no coding needed. Generate code, debug errors, and get step-by-step explanations.

VOICE MODE & VOICE TO TEXT
Ask out loud while cooking, driving, or walking, and get clear spoken answers in real time. Or skip typing and let voice-to-text do it.

IMAGE & DOCUMENT ANALYSIS
Snap a photo of a chart, a whiteboard, or handwritten notes and get a clear explanation.

WHAT USERS SAY
"I've tested at least 12 AI platforms for work. With four paid subscriptions for comparison, this one is the way to go." - Sohail R., US
"Works amazingly fast and has cut my work and life load in half." - Nienie, US
"At 71, learning something new is usually a non-starter. I needed research, and this app saved me HOURS." - Hoosier R., US
"All the solutions in one app, no need to download other apps." - Lokki, US

WHY CHATNOW
- 30+ models in one place, not one model per plan
- New models added as they launch, nothing to chase
- Text, images, video, research, and code side by side
- One price instead of five subscriptions

IS CHATNOW FREE?
Yes, ChatNow is free to download and you can start chatting right away. A subscription unlocks all 30+ models and features.

IS MY DATA PRIVATE?
Yes. ChatNow follows European data protection standards. Your conversations and content stay private.

WHO CHATNOW IS FOR
- PROFESSIONALS: draft reports, analyze data, and decide faster
- RESEARCHERS & LEARNERS: summarize sources and understand complex topics
- CREATORS: generate images, video, and content ideas
- ANYONE: ask in plain language and get help with everyday questions

Download ChatNow for free and make AI your advantage.

*Total downloads as of 2026.
